name: mpi-knn3-screen-v1
single_change: patch anomaly distance is the mean of 3 nearest original raw-feature bank rows
selection_rule: 12 baseline true positives with lowest SHA256(salt NUL key), fixed before candidate GPU scores
calibration: unchanged development128 median/Q90 and calibration169 higher Q95, max12, top1 map mean
gate: all 12 selected prior detections retained; no threshold adjustment or replacement cases
reload_if_gate_passes: first 8 fixed calibration photos and the same 12 regression cases; raw tolerance 1e-4, zero decision flips
scope: screen only; no test109/validation256 full evaluation, masks, bootstrap, training or model adoption
